name: fastlivo2-ros1
description: Third-party C++ dependencies for the FAST-LIVO2 ROS1 workspace, managed via vcpkg manifest mode. Only libraries that ROS does NOT also provide belong here to avoid ABI conflicts with system PCL/OpenCV/Eigen. If a library is an indirect dependency of one required here—for example, Sophus depends on Eigen3—then its version should be aligned with the version installed on the system.
